mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, which reduces the discount rate applied to future corporate earnings, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances despite a declining FEDFUNDS trend, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate above 5.7% within one month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which raises expectations of future monetary policy accommodation and reduces inflationary pressure, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the average 20-day return in triggered periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential construction (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) signals weakening aggregate demand, which increases the likelihood of central bank intervention, thereby boosting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in a regression of 60-day returns on the interaction term.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below 105.0 for two consecutive months indicates a contraction in real output, which increases the probability of monetary stimulus and reduces inflation expectations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the average 20-day return in triggered periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.0% and inflation (CPIAUCSL) remains above 3.5%, the market prices in a high-conviction monetary tightening regime, which increases the risk of recession and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction term has a positive coefficient with p > 0.05 in a regression model.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in non-farm payroll growth (PAYEMS) above 250k in a single month signals strong labor demand, which increases inflationary pressure and raises the likelihood of aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the average 5-day return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in residential construction (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) signals robust aggregate demand, which raises inflation expectations and increases the probability of delayed rate cuts, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal fails to produce negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in a regression model.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 105.0 for three consecutive months, combined with a rising unemployment rate (UNRATE), indicates a deepening supply-side contraction and labor market stress, which increases the likelihood of aggressive monetary easing and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < 105.0 for 3 consecutive months AND UNRATE > 5.5
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in less than 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05) in a regression model.
